Architecture

Form, light, and space.

Architecture is frozen music — rhythm in stone, glass, and steel. I photograph buildings and spaces with an eye for composition and light, finding the lines and angles that reveal the intention behind the design. From ancient temples to modern structures, every building has a story to tell.
